name: openstatus
description: Runs status pages, uptime checks from 28 regions, and incident response as code, operable by agents through an MCP server, a --json CLI, Terraform, and a typed API.

skills.name: Status Pages
skills.description: Publishes status pages with custom domains, maintenance windows, and email and RSS subscriber notices.

skills.name: Uptime Monitoring
skills.description: Checks servers, websites, and APIs from 28 regions and alerts via Slack, PagerDuty, email, and more.

skills.name: Incident Response
skills.description: Declares, updates, and resolves incidents with severity, commander, and timeline from the dashboard or Slack.

skills.name: Monitoring as Code
skills.description: Declares monitors, notifications, and status pages in YAML or Terraform and applies them from the CLI or CI.

skills.name: MCP Server
skills.description: Connects Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, or any MCP client to the workspace with the same API key.
